title: The doctor reads each finished run's seal once, not once per source change
outcome: The doctor reads each finished run's seal once, not once per source change
acceptance: The doctor's check of source-change obligations loads a finished run's completion cut at most once per run, and a test shows that its report on a store with late source changes is unchanged

completion.summary: Doctor's source-change obligation check now reads each finished run's sealed cut once per run, through a per-run cache filled where it was read before. Errors and skip paths are unchanged. A test-only counter and a test show one read for a run with two late changes, with an unchanged clean report, mutation-checked (2 reads without the cache). Round 1 was clean, gate 9/9 with credit, and the evaluation passed. Landed as febe88c and installed as build 680052fd.
